task: MM-FIX-3 — Existing Maven JaCoCo argLine compatibility
rootCause: The test-fork listener invoked IAgent.dump(true), which wrote to the project-owned JaCoCo destfile, then looked only for STP's assumed stp.exec.dir/test.exec. SonarJava wrote target/jacoco.exec, so no STP session exec was copied.
previousAssumption: The active JaCoCo agent destination was stp.exec.dir/test.exec (target/jacoco/test.exec for Maven).
newJacocoCaptureMechanism: The listener and Jupiter extension reuse RT.getAgent() in the test fork, reset before each test, call IAgent.getExecutionData(true) after each test, and append the standard exec bytes directly to STP-owned module-local session_*.exec files.
